title: NREL Mesa 1-axis: tracker stall (2024-04-25 to 2024-05-04)
summary: Tracker stall detected at NREL Mesa 1-axis (Golden, CO) over 10 day(s), 2024-04-25 to 2024-05-04. Estimated cost so far: $1,374.
evidence: Performance index fell from 1.00 in the two weeks before to a median of 0.78 during the event (1.00 = healthy).
Estimated energy lost: 11,451 kWh (23% of expected), about $1,374.
Morning and evening output ran 39 points further below expectation than midday output.
Output holds up at midday but falls short in the morning and evening, the signature of tracker rows that stopped following the sun (parked or stuck).
likely_causes: Tracker controller fault or lost communications
Stow mode left active after high wind
Failed drive motor or row power supply
recommended_actions: Check the tracker controller (TCU/NCU) for alarms, stow commands and lost communications
Compare reported vs commanded row angles to find which rows are stuck
Clear any wind or snow stow left active; reset the controller
On site: inspect drive motors, slew gears and row power supplies on stuck rows
safety_notes: Follow site lockout/tagout and arc-flash procedures before opening any DC or AC enclosure.

title: NREL Mesa 1-axis: full outage (2024-10-12 to 2024-10-13)
summary: Full outage detected at NREL Mesa 1-axis (Golden, CO) over 2 day(s), 2024-10-12 to 2024-10-13. Estimated cost so far: $949.
evidence: Performance index fell from 0.99 in the two weeks before to a median of 0.00 during the event (1.00 = healthy).
Estimated energy lost: 7,904 kWh (100% of expected), about $949.
likely_causes: Inverter trip (ground fault, over-temperature, grid event)
recommended_actions: Check SCADA / inverter alarm log for the trip code and time of the first fault
Confirm grid availability with the utility before dispatch (rule out a feeder outage)
If alarms allow, attempt one remote reset; otherwise dispatch a technician
On site: inspect inverter, AC disconnect and breakers; follow lockout/tagout
safety_notes: Follow site lockout/tagout and arc-flash procedures before opening any DC or AC enclosure.
